text:
maya: Quick check — attribution pipeline started failing for a subset of events after yesterday's schema bump. anyone available for fast triage?
jonathan: saw the alert. attrib job errors when user_tier is missing. PR earlier required user_tier? cc @priya
priya: we made event.user_tier required for billing; backfill didn't finish before deploy, my mistake.
sam: can we short-circuit attribution for missing user_tier until backfill completes? avoid analytics/cost noise.
jonathan: options: 1) skip attribution for missing user_tier (fast); 2) fallback to "unknown" and emit metric (safer); 3) replay after backfill. which do teams want?
lia-analytics: skipping will drop ~0.7% token rows, mostly internal/test orgs — dashboards will blip but tolerable.
priya: backfill ETA ~6h if prioritized; kicked off now.
maya: agree on a short defensive fix + canary. sam can you open quick PR to tolerate missing field and emit metric?
sam: opening tiny patch now. code snippet:
```python
user_tier = event.get("user_tier") or "unknown"
if user_tier == "unknown":
    metrics.counter("attrib.missing_user_tier")
```
jonathan: plan: canary to prod-dedicated 10m, watch error rate and cost delta, then roll to hosted if good. I'll run at 10:15 PT.
sam: deploying canary to prod-dedicated now...
``
deploy: attrib-worker v2.1.1 -> canary
status: healthy (0 errors in 2m)
```
priya: backfill progress 12% complete, ~3.5h remaining. no blockers.
lia-analytics: added dashboard note and saved query for affected orgs. SQL used for checks:
```sql
select org_id, count(*) as tokens, sum(cost) from tokens
where user_tier is null
group by org_id
order by tokens desc
limit 10;
```
ingest-bot: [alert] attrib-worker error rate spiked to 4.2% at 2026-03-16T09:42:00Z; ingest lag +30s.
maya: owners/next steps: ownership = @jonathan + @priya; immediate mitigation = sam's fallback + canary; backfill = priya; monitoring = lia; replay skipped events after backfill = jonathan. reconvene if ETA slips. :thumbsup:
jonathan: will post final rollout result after hosted deploy.
sam: adding one-liner to release notes: "attrib: tolerate missing user_tier during backfill".
priya: will follow up with backfill logs and create schema-rollout checklist ticket to prevent this next time.
maya: closing loop unless new failures crop up.
